## About (Full)

Twin Cities Towing INC has been serving the Richmond and Rosenberg, Texas areas since 2011, providing reliable emergency towing services to stranded motorists around the clock. With 13+ years of combined experience in the industry, the company has built a strong reputation for trust and dependability among local drivers who need assistance when they're stuck on the side of the road.

Specializing in towing services for cars, small trucks, and motorcycles, Twin Cities Towing offers comprehensive roadside assistance whenever drivers need it most. Their commitment to being available at all hours ensures that help is always close by for motorists in Richmond, Rosenberg, and the surrounding areas. The company's dedication to prompt response and careful vehicle handling has made them a trusted choice for emergency towing throughout Fort Bend County.

Twin Cities Towing operates without a call center — customers reach real dispatch when they call, resulting in faster, more accurate response coordination. The company regularly responds to breakdowns along I-69 (US-59), Highway 90, Business 90, FM 359, and all major Fort Bend County roadways, and coordinates with TxDOT and law enforcement when highway safety situations require it.

## Services (Detailed)

### Emergency Towing
Available 24/7. Twin Cities Towing INC dispatches immediately upon your call with no hold queue and no transfer to a national center. Response time: 20–40 minutes to most Fort Bend County locations. Coverage includes all major highways: I-69/US-59, Highway 90, Business 90, FM 359, and all local Richmond and Rosenberg roads.

### Flatbed Towing
Full flatbed service for luxury cars, AWD and 4WD vehicles, low-clearance automobiles, race cars, and accident-damaged vehicles where tow-bar contact would cause further damage. All four wheels off the ground — zero drivetrain contact. Preferred method for any vehicle where wheel-lift is not appropriate.

### Car Towing
Reliable towing for all passenger vehicles including sedans, coupes, hatchbacks, and wagons. Safe transport to any mechanic, dealership, impound, or private address in Fort Bend County and surrounding areas.

### Truck Towing
Heavy-duty and commercial vehicle towing for box trucks, large pickup trucks, commercial vans, and fleet vehicles. Twin Cities Towing has the equipment and experience to handle vehicles that exceed standard tow capacity.

### Light Duty Towing
Standard towing for everyday passenger vehicles including cars, SUVs, and small pickup trucks. Wheel-lift or flatbed based on vehicle type. Efficient service with careful vehicle handling throughout the process.

### Motorcycle Towing
Specialized motorcycle transport using wheel chocks, soft straps, and proper mounting cradles. Safe transport for motorcycles, scooters, and ATVs without risking paint, bodywork, or mechanical components. The driver secures the bike before moving — no shortcuts.

### Accident Towing
24/7 accident recovery and collision towing. Twin Cities Towing coordinates with Richmond PD, Fort Bend County Sheriff, and TxDOT when clearing accident scenes. Vehicles delivered to body shops, dealerships, or storage as directed by the owner or insurance adjuster.

### Breakdown Towing
Transport for vehicles with engine failures, transmission problems, overheating, or any mechanical condition that prevents self-propulsion. Whether the car is dead on a freeway or stalled in a parking lot, Twin Cities Towing gets it to the right shop.

### Roadside Assistance
On-site help before resorting to a tow: jump starts for dead batteries, fuel delivery for vehicles that ran dry, and flat tire changes using the spare. These services get you moving faster than a tow when possible.

### Tire Change Service
On-site spare tire installation when you're stranded with a flat. The driver comes to your location with the tools to remove the flat and mount your spare — whether you're on a highway shoulder or a side street.

### Lockout Service
Car lockout assistance for when keys are locked inside the vehicle. Twin Cities Towing INC uses professional tools to unlock your vehicle without damaging the door, window, or lock mechanism. Available throughout Fort Bend County, typically within 30 minutes.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How fast can Twin Cities Towing respond to an emergency in Richmond, TX?
A: Most emergency calls within Richmond and Fort Bend County see a driver on-site within 20–40 minutes. We dispatch immediately — no hold queue, no call center transfer.

Q: Is Twin Cities Towing available on holidays and overnight?
A: Yes. 24/7 means every hour of every day — including Christmas, Thanksgiving, and 3am on a Sunday. There are no off-hours.

Q: Do you respond to highway breakdowns on I-69 and Highway 90?
A: Yes. We regularly respond to I-69 (US-59), Highway 90, Business 90, FM 359, and all major Fort Bend County roadways. We coordinate with TxDOT and law enforcement when needed.

Q: What vehicles can you tow?
A: Cars, SUVs, pickup trucks, box trucks, motorcycles, scooters, ATVs, and commercial vehicles. We use flatbed or wheel-lift based on the vehicle type and condition.

Q: Can you tow an AWD or 4WD vehicle?
A: Yes — using our flatbed, all four wheels are lifted completely off the ground, which is the only safe way to tow an AWD vehicle without drivetrain damage.

Q: Do you tow motorcycles?
A: Yes. We use wheel chocks, soft straps, and proper cradles to transport motorcycles safely. No improvised tie-downs.

Q: What should I do if I'm stranded on the highway?
A: Stay in your vehicle if it's safe, turn on hazard lights, and call us. Give us your location — a mile marker, cross street, or highway direction — and we dispatch immediately.

Q: Do you handle accident scenes?
A: Yes. Twin Cities Towing responds to collision scenes and coordinates with law enforcement and TxDOT when required. We deliver the vehicle to your body shop, dealership, or storage of choice.

Q: Is Twin Cities Towing licensed and insured?
A: Yes. Twin Cities Towing INC is licensed and insured to operate throughout Texas.

Q: How long has Twin Cities Towing been in business?
A: Since 2011 — 13+ years serving Richmond, Rosenberg, and Fort Bend County.
